items.title: Show HN: An e-ink frame that hears birds and draws them as 1800s illustrations
items.title_zh: 电子墨水相框聆听鸟鸣，并将其绘制成19世纪风格插画
items.title_en: E-Ink Frame Listens for Birds and Draws Them as 1800s Illustrations
items.summary: A Show HN project presenting an e-ink picture frame that listens for bird calls, classifies them with BirdNET, and renders the detected species as 1800s-style illustrations.

items.title: Gemini 3.8 Live and 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.title_zh: 谷歌发布 Gemini 3.8 Live 与 Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.title_en: Google launches Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking
items.summary: Google announced Gemini 3.8 Live and Gemini 3.8 Live Extended Thinking, prompting HN discussion about its voice chat quality, multilingual capabilities, latency, and competitive standing.

items.title: We got admin access to Baseten's production GitHub in 25 minutes
items.title_zh: AI 渗透测试智能体在 Docker 历史记录中发现 Baseten 的 GitHub 令牌
items.title_en: AI Pentest Agent Finds Baseten GitHub Token in Docker History
items.summary: A security team using an AI pentesting agent found a Baseten bot's GitHub personal access token exposed in Docker image history, giving admin access to key production repositories.

items.title: 25 years of mass surveillance is enough
items.title_zh: 布鲁斯·施奈尔：25年的大规模监控已经够了
items.title_en: Bruce Schneier: 25 Years of Mass Surveillance Is Enough
items.summary: Bruce Schneier argues that 25 years of mass surveillance is enough, sparking a high-engagement Hacker News discussion on privacy, totalitarian control, and potential policy and technical responses.

items.title: Everyone Says Datacenter Moratoriums Are Killing the US Buildout. We disagree
items.title_zh: SemiAnalysis：数据中心禁令全国仅影响约2.3GW容量
items.title_en: SemiAnalysis: Datacenter Moratoriums Stall Only 2.3GW Nationwide
items.summary: A SemiAnalysis analysis argues that local datacenter moratoriums have a much smaller impact than widely claimed, with only about 2.3GW of capacity actually slipping nationwide despite 20GW sitting inside restricted boundaries.

items.title: TabPFN-3.5 is released as the next SOTA tabular foundation model [N]
items.title_zh: Prior Labs 发布 TabPFN-3.5，成为新的表格基础模型 SOTA
items.title_en: Prior Labs releases TabPFN-3.5, new SOTA tabular foundation model
items.summary: Prior Labs released TabPFN-3.5, a new state-of-the-art tabular foundation model, with fast, thinking, and plus variants leading multiple benchmarks.

items.title: 联发科发布天玑9600 Pro
items.title_zh: 联发科发布天玑9600 Pro，首款采用台积电2纳米制程的手机芯片
items.title_en: MediaTek Unveils Dimensity 9600 Pro, Its First TSMC 2nm Mobile Chip
items.summary: MediaTek announced the Dimensity 9600 Pro, its first flagship mobile chip built on TSMC's 2nm process, and the 3nm Dimensity 9600M, with major AI performance gains.
